g.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
g.text: I am Bagas, an IT student at Gunadarma University
(class of 2024). I like figuring out how things
work and making them work better, whether that is
a workflow, a tool, or a website.
I learn mostly by doing. I have set up my own
homelab as a personal cloud, used AdGuard Home and
Pi-hole on my network, tried many Linux distros,
and cleaned up Windows as far as possible without
I have tried a wide range of AI models and tools,
and I am interested in how they fit into real
workflows. On the creative side, I design in
Figma, Canva, and other tools, and I enjoy
building interactive websites, including the ones
I made for my course presentations.
